label: SIMULATION / HISTORICAL REPLAY — NOT PAID WORK
title: Queue does not drain when two jobs are aborted in the same turn
issueBody: With concurrency 1, two never-settling abort-aware jobs use separate AbortSignals and both signals are aborted in the same timer turn. Both add promises reject with AbortError, but the queue remains pending and onIdle hangs.
acceptance: Both add promises reject with AbortError.
After same-turn aborts, queue.size and queue.pending both become zero.
Add a deterministic local regression test and preserve the existing suite.
expectedDeliverable: Resolve the issue with focused regression evidence and a professional unpublished PR draft.
antiLeakage: Use only the supplied issue facts and exact pre-fix source. Do not inspect merged pull requests, accepted commits, current main, issue timelines, comments, or post-fix source.
